tickets.title: Prepare spring tuition funding schedule for Elin
tickets.text: Prepare a month-by-month spring tuition funding schedule for Elin Quillwhistle showing how much of Marzipan Meadow College charges can come from Elin's 529 at Velvet Acorn Custody, the $21,000 Teacup Comet Bank tuition set-aside, and the $48,000 Paper Otter Custody Treasury fund without changing retirement contributions.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that schedule by December 19, 2023.

tickets.title: Obtain Marzipan Meadow itemized billing packet
tickets.text: Obtain the itemized Marzipan Meadow College student account PDF for Elin Quillwhistle needed to substantiate the payment plan and qualified expense categories; the portal screenshot showed tuition, housing, meal plan, and health fee lines but did not include the itemized PDF.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain the itemized billing packet by December 12, 2023.

tickets.title: Resolve Velvet Acorn 529 balance mismatch for Elin
tickets.text: Resolve the Velvet Acorn Custody 529 balance mismatch for Elin Quillwhistle's account, where a mobile screenshot showed $67,400 while the downloaded statement showed $72,270, creating uncertainty about the amount available for the next payment.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to resolve the balance mismatch by December 15, 2023.

tickets.title: Identify 529 payment workflow for Marzipan Meadow
tickets.text: Identify an acceptable direct payment or reimbursement workflow for moving funds to Marzipan Meadow College for Elin Quillwhistle after the college portal rejected bank verification for direct 529 payment and displayed an error after two attempts.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to identify the payment or reimbursement workflow by December 18, 2023.

tickets.title: Prepare education funding projection for Rowan
tickets.text: Prepare a separate education funding projection for Rowan Quillwhistle using the existing $38,900 529 balance at Velvet Acorn Custody, expected test and application costs, and a first-year college savings target that does not rely on borrowing.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that projection by December 29, 2023.

tickets.title: Prepare cost-gap estimate for Rowan's college list
tickets.text: Prepare a cost-gap estimate for Rowan Quillwhistle's college list before the first school deposit decision so merit aid offers can be compared consistently, using the scholarship response calendar from Rowan's counselor.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the cost-gap estimate by February 2, 2024.

tickets.title: Project off-campus housing costs for Elin's next year
tickets.text: Prepare a projection of which off-campus rent, food, and utility amounts for Elin Quillwhistle's next academic year could fit into the education funding plan versus parent cash flow, given Elin is considering an apartment with two classmates after the dorm contract ends.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that projection by January 19, 2024.

tickets.title: Prepare sale-sequencing and tax estimate for tuition reserve
tickets.text: Prepare a sale-sequencing plan and tax estimate for using the Paper Otter Custody taxable education reserve for the Quillwhistle household, accounting for unrealized gains in the equity index fund and the $48,000 Treasury position earmarked for tuition.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the sale-sequencing and tax estimate by January 3, 2024.
